title: Anthropic live key check must send anthropic-workspace-id
goal: susi keys check / keys models report Anthropic as Unreachable because auth_headers omits the anthropic-workspace-id header that a workspace-scoped key requires (the API answers 400, which classifies as Unreachable). Send the header when ANTHROPIC_WORKSPACE_ID is configured, with a pure unit test for the header set.
